verdict.rationale: Shopify's POS features page documents Sidekick, its built-in AI assistant. Merchants can ask it for reordering suggestions and can have it recommend stock transfers between locations and create them automatically, which is genuine task delegation. The documented scope is narrow (inventory reordering and transfers), and it is unclear whether Sidekick runs inside the POS app or only in the Shopify back office. missing for 10: evidence of delegation beyond inventory tasks, confirmation Sidekick is available inside the POS app itself, in-depth Sidekick docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Ask Sidekick to recommend stock transfers between locations based on performance trends, and create them for you automatically.
Use Sidekick, Shopify’s AI assistant, to get reordering suggestions based on sales velocity and seasonality.
